lenses.prepare: Gather tools, skills, and resources before an important attempt.
lenses.presentation: Shape how the person or project appears to an audience or evaluator.
lenses.appeal: Seek the attention, approval, or goodwill of someone with influence.
lenses.visibility: Make a person, message, or work visible to a wider audience.
lenses.growth: Seek increase, followers, opportunities, or a flourishing result.
lenses.prosperity: Seek money, material gain, or a better livelihood.
lenses.chance: Hope for an uncertain outcome that cannot be guaranteed or controlled.
lenses.competition: Seek advantage in a contest, ranking, or rivalry.
lenses.protection: Keep an unwanted influence, loss, or setback away.
lenses.release: Let go of a harmful condition, obstacle, or failed past attempt.
lenses.renewal: Move from a difficult state toward recovery or a fresh start.
lenses.transition: Cross into a new role, stage, place, or status.
lenses.connection: Build ties, trust, or reciprocal relationships.
lenses.persistence: Sustain effort or wait through a period before the desired change.

prepare-material.role: Assemble the resources for a later act.

place-deposit.role: Place a prepared object where it can remain present during the rite.

remove-deposit.role: Lift away an object after its prescribed period.

purify-by-analogy.role: Use a comparison to turn an unwanted state into its opposite.

make-offering.role: Give something valued while seeking a favorable response.

invoke-help.role: Address a powerful recipient and ask for aid.

collect-material.role: Find and gather what the next act needs.

construct-setting.role: Make a bounded place for a change to happen.

fashion-figure.role: Give a problem, hope, or person a material stand-in.

mark-subject.role: Dress or mark the subject for a new role or encounter.

transfer-affliction.role: Move an unwanted condition onto a carrier that can be taken away.

destroy-affliction.role: Break or burn a carrier of an unwanted condition.

wash-clean.role: Wash the subject to mark a fresh condition.

remove-mark.role: Remove a temporary marker after the change it signaled.

discard-carrier.role: Send a used carrier away from the subject.

cross-threshold.role: Pass through a marked boundary into another state.

affirm-cleansing.role: State aloud that the desired change has been completed.

seek-fertility.role: Use living abundance as an image of desired increase.

dispatch-substitute.role: Send a stand-in away carrying a burden from the group.

appease-divinity.role: Seek reconciliation and favor from a powerful recipient.

return-harm.role: Turn a hostile act back toward its originator.

sleep-over-deposit.role: Let a prepared arrangement remain through the night.

cook-offering.role: Complete the preparation of a gift for its recipient.

kill-for-offering.role: An animal is killed in the historical offering sequence; this has no modern action equivalent.
